svg.title: Application delivery services and security boundaries
svg.desc: Three comparison lanes show Traffic Manager DNS selection, regional Application Gateway WAF and internal Load Balancer, and global Front Door Premium with Private Link to App Service. These lanes are not implicitly chained into one deployment.
